senses.gloss: ? āmbhirya, (m. or nt.) ˚rye LV 〔156.21〕 (prose), one of the arts (kalā); from the context (after bārhaspatye and before āsurye) perhaps a philosophic system; v.l. ambhīrye (also ācīrye, asvīrye, but Tib. chuḥi lugs, way, or system, of water indicates that the orig. began ambh- or āmbh-, tho it does not give much further help).
